job.titel: Global Industrial Lead for GCP (all genders)
job.beschreibung:
We Are
We are seeking a highly experienced Industrial and Automation Leader to drive the Fourth Industrial Revolution (Industry 4.0) for the world’s leading manufacturing and industrial organizations. In this leadership role, you will help position Google Cloud as the foundational platform for smart factories, resilient supply chains, and intelligent industrial products.
Working with clients across discrete manufacturing, process manufacturing, and industrial automation, you will help organizations harness the power of data, AI, and advanced cloud technologies to significantly improve operational efficiency, quality, and innovation. The ideal candidate brings a strong understanding of factory operations, operational technology (OT), and digital manufacturing transformation, along with a clear vision for the future of Industry 4.0.
You Are
A recognized industry expert in manufacturing, industrial automation, and smart factory transformation.
Experienced in operational technology (OT), industrial control systems, and modern cloud platforms.
Passionate about helping organizations unlock value through data, AI, and digital engineering.
Comfortable engaging with C-suite executives, manufacturing leaders, and engineering teams.
A strategic thinker who can translate complex industrial challenges into scalable technology solutions.
A strong communicator and thought leader capable of shaping industry conversations and market direction.
You Will
Drive Industry Strategy
You will define and lead the go-to-market strategy for industrial manufacturing and automation, positioning cloud, data, and AI technologies as key enablers of the factory of the future. You will represent the voice of industrial customers internally and translate their needs into strategic initiatives and innovative solutions.
Lead Smart Factory Transformation
You will advise senior executives and manufacturing leaders on their Industry 4.0 transformation journey, helping design and implement smart factory capabilities such as digital twins, predictive maintenance, and AI-driven quality control.
Enable Data and AI Innovation
You will drive the adoption of advanced analytics, machine learning, and AI technologies to optimize industrial processes, improve operational performance, and enable intelligent automation across production environments.
Integrate IT and OT Ecosystems
You will help organizations unify IT and operational technology (OT) environments, enabling real-time data integration from industrial systems such as PLCs, SCADA platforms, and IoT devices to create a unified operational view across global manufacturing operations.
Build Resilient Supply Chains
You will support the development of data-driven supply chain solutions that improve forecasting, inventory optimization, and logistics visibility, helping organizations move toward predictive and resilient supply chain models.
Develop Ecosystem Partnerships and Thought Leadership
You will collaborate with leading industrial automation vendors, technology partners, and system integrators, while also representing the organization as a thought leader at industry forums and events, shaping the future vision of AI-enabled manufacturing and industrial transformation.
Qualifications
Minimum Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial) or a related technical discipline.
15+ years of experience in a senior leadership role within a major industrial, manufacturing, or automation organization.
Deep domain expertise in manufacturing operations and industrial technologies, including MES, SCADA, PLM, and industrial control systems.
Proven track record of leading large-scale operational improvement or digital transformation initiatives in manufacturing or industrial environments.
Preferred Qualifications
Master’s degree or PhD in a relevant technical or business discipline.
Experience leveraging public cloud platforms (preferably Google Cloud) for industrial use cases such as Industrial IoT, AI/ML for manufacturing, or supply chain analytics.
Knowledge of industrial data protocols and standards such as OPC-UA and MQTT.
Established executive-level network with leaders at major industrial companies and automation vendors.
Exceptional executive presence and communication skills, with the technical credibility to advise senior engineering and operations leaders and serve as a recognized industry evangelist.
You and Accenture
In this role, you’ll be part of Accenture Technology’s SAP Business Group. We leverage the full spectrum of digital technologies to simplify our clients’ everyday operations and lead their businesses into the future—from #CustomerExperience to #GenAI, from #SAPDataManagement to #360°ValueDifferentiation.
The Accenture Culture: Here, YOU Make the Difference
Your skills, personality, and ambitions make you unique. And when diverse talents, strengths, and perspectives come together, something extraordinary happens: ideas that truly make an impact. That’s why Accenture champions diversity and individual freedom. Create a work environment where you thrive—with tasks you care about, a workload that suits you, and a working style aligned with your goals. How you network, learn, and grow personally is up to you. It’s your career. We’re here to help you shape it the way you envision.
Your Contact
Still have questions? Feel free to reach out to our recruiting team by email at recruiting_germany@accenture.com or by phone at 00800 45045045.
We look forward to your application!
About Accenture
Accenture is a leading global professional services company that helps the world’s leading businesses, governments and other organizations build their digital core, optimize their operations, accelerate revenue growth and enhance citizen services—creating tangible value at speed and scale. We are a talent- and innovation-led company with approximately 791,000 people serving clients in more than 120 countries. Technology is at the core of change today, and we are one of the world’s leaders in helping drive that change, with strong ecosystem relationships. We combine our strength in technology and leadership in cloud, data and AI with unmatched industry experience, functional expertise and global delivery capability. Our broad range of services, solutions and assets across Strategy & Consulting, Technology, Operations, Industry X and Song, together with our culture of shared success and commitment to creating 360° value, enable us to help our clients reinvent and build trusted, lasting relationships. We measure our success by the 360° value we create for our clients, each other, our shareholders, partners and communities.Visit us at www.accenture.com
